lines.text: DoorDash rebuilt the system that picks your driver, and it now handles ten times more.
Dispatch decides which driver picks up which order.
lines.title: What is dispatch?

lines.text: The old engine did everything in one big program. At peak, demand was about four times what it could process.
lines.title: The problem

lines.text: A coordinator keeps the big picture and splits the map into small areas. Workers solve each area in parallel.
lines.title: How it works

lines.text: DoorDash first ran the new system quietly beside the old one, and compared the answers.
lines.title: Safe rollout

lines.text: During Super Bowl Sunday, the new platform stayed available more than 99.99 percent of the time.
lines.title: The result

lines.text: The takeaway: keep the memory in one place, and spread the heavy thinking across helpers.
lines.title: Takeaways
